original.statement: The configuration keys async_cache_write_back_concurrency and async_cache_write_back_buffer_size have been removed in favor of Background cache configuration settings (writeback_goroutines, writeback_buffer, and writeback_size_limit).

decision.reason: [ev-576bad2a0aa0] says directly that the configuration `async_cache_write_back_concurrency` has been removed and that this setting "can be set with `writeback_goroutines`" in the `Background` cache configuration. That supports the subject as config-key path=async_cache_write_back_concurrency, with the key names copied exactly from the text. It also supports the change as removed, replacedBy writeback_goroutines. The same note also removes async_cache_write_back_buffer_size, but that is a separate removal of its own; this assertion covers one key correctly and does not mix the two.
